**Section:** 3. Test Harness Contract
**Change:** + contract/agent-run-selection/session — agent-run run selection · session
~ contract/agent-run-verbs/run · promise: was «run {selection} runs cargo test -p blitz-tests --locked with merged output to run.log, truncated at the run's start, sets status.json's run state running then passed or failed, and parses libtest's pretty lines into events.»; now «run {selection} runs cargo test --locked, -p blitz-tests under stand, all and a file name and -p seven_guis --test cli_flow under session, merged output to run.log truncated at its start, sets status.json's run state running then passed or failed, and parses libtest's pretty lines into events.»

**Why:** contract/agent-run-selection/session: The run verb takes a fourth selection word, session, beside stand, all and a file name, and no selection row states it.
contract/agent-run-verbs/run: The run verb now reaches two packages, seven_guis under the session selection alone, so a promise of cargo test -p blitz-tests for every run is false.
decision/agent-run-holds-no-process: The session selection runs seven_guis' cli_flow flows, whose own session hosts the script neither starts nor holds, so the exception must name them beside the two stand checks.
decision/test-data-is-code: boot still builds blitz-tests alone while run session's cargo call builds seven_guis, so fixtures compiled into each target by boot is no longer true of every target.
**Ref:** .andromeda/runs/2026-11-16T00-24-03-wrap/
